# CareerSignal

> AI career operating system: build an ATS-ready CV, match it against any job description, see your shortlisting signal, and manage your job search end to end.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and primary call to action.
- [Product](/product): Detailed look at all eight CareerSignal modules.
- [CV Score](/cv-score): How CareerSignal scores and explains CVs.
- [JD Match](/jd-match): Match a CV against any job description with AI.
- [Jobs](/jobs): Public preview of the intelligent job feed.
- [For Recruiters](/for-recruiters): AI-powered shortlisting and JD quality tools.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans for candidates, recruiters, and career centers.
